steps.speaker: Crache Narration
steps.content: Did I lose...

steps.speaker: Crache Narration
steps.content: Lose to these... bastards...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll think about capturing you later. Right now, I have a favor to ask you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: As the guardian of children, I want to ask you to protect those two.

She's always tried her best, whether in the mines, the streets, or the Drifter Camp. Her bravery can be traced even earlier, to when the Homeless first formed, and to when she first became a Sinner—Crache had always been fighting to protect others.
Yet as slumps to the ground, the only thing protecting her is her little shadow.

The blurry, distorted figures approach her one by one. They're the "New Syndicans", yet also the same old Syndicans who prey on the weak. They will not show mercy to this little tyke at the bottom of the food chain.
From now on, there will be no one to protect other little tykes.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Haha... so this is the future...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Is it still gonna be like this... Nothing changed at all...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Go eat sh*t...
The shadows stop moving. She has no more strength. She wants to close her eyes and wait for her miserable life to end by the violence she despises most.
Yet in the last moment before losing consciousness, the shadows scattered on the ground shoot out and pierce every "Sinner" around Crache.

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: What's happening? She already fainted, but the shadows are still...
A woman speaks up.
Like they say... Ignorance is dangerous... The uneducated will always see black as just black.

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Raven from Rustfire... What are you doing here?!

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Oh, right! You're here to get ${PlayerName}, too! You...

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: We'll talk about that in a bit. Right now, I'm very angry.
Dozens of ravens suddenly break in to attack the crowd, opening up a path.
The poet comes up to her fallen student from the other side of the road and helps her up in front of ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: ...Don't be scared! Don't panic! Her ink will be used up soon! She won't be able to hold out much longer! Call for backup! We have more than enough people!

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: The weapon of a poet is her thoughts, which gets conveyed through her writing. I'm quite lazy, so I didn't write that much.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: I happen to run a school around here. I wrote a few dozen textbooks and a couple hundred poems. I finally met a student I liked enough to pass on my work to. But look what you did to her.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: I must... avenge her.
Ink rains down from the roof and bursts into sprouts from the ground, dying the whole space black.
